splits.name: standard_heldout
splits.description: Full held-out test split with its natural class distribution.
splits.caveat: Class imbalance is extreme; macro-F1 is the honest headline, not accuracy.

splits.name: language_hindi
splits.caveat: Small sample; per-class figures will be unstable.

splits.name: language_hinglish
splits.caveat: Small sample; per-class figures will be unstable.

splits.name: language_tamil
splits.reason: The corpus contains no Tamil. Tamil intent/behaviour classification is not supported and must not be described as supported.

splits.name: social_engineering
splits.description: Records exhibiting at least one social-engineering behaviour.

splits.name: human_scam
splits.description: Scam records from real-world corpora, excluding synthetically generated ones.
splits.caveat: Tests whether risk is driven by semantics rather than by generation artefacts.

splits.name: synthetic_but_legitimate
splits.description: Machine-generated but legitimate messages, to test that synthetic origin alone does not raise risk.
splits.reason: No corpus record is labelled both synthetic-origin and legitimate. Synthetic_Tier_C records are synthetic AND scam, so they cannot separate the two factors.

splits.name: benchmark_ground_truth
splits.reason: Only 1 held-out record(s) - below the 30-record minimum for a meaningful metric. Reported as blocked rather than built.

splits.name: generator_disjoint
splits.description: Anti-spoofing evaluation where test-set generators are unseen in training.
splits.reason: No anti-spoofing corpus was acquired. ASVspoof requires registration, and AASIST is used as a pretrained checkpoint without independent evaluation. No EER can be reported.

splits.name: codec_noise_robustness
splits.description: Codec, bandwidth and noise degradation robustness.
splits.reason: Requires an audio corpus. The text classifiers cannot be evaluated for acoustic robustness.

splits.name: speaker_disjoint
splits.description: Speaker verification with speakers unseen in training.
splits.reason: No speaker corpus was acquired; VoxCeleb requires a request form. ECAPA-TDNN is used pretrained, and there is no enrolment source anyway.

splits.name: asr_hindi
splits.reason: No real ASR model is loadable: the AI4Bharat repositories are gated and return 403 on download.

splits.name: asr_tamil
splits.reason: Blocked by both the gated ASR model and the absence of Tamil data.

note: Unavailable splits are recorded rather than dropped. An evaluation that omits them must say so; none may be reported as passed.
